system.description: Give minor medical aid to yourself or someone else. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, the patient regains 1 Health Bar slot. Each higher degree of Success heals 1 additional slot.

upgrades.description: If you spend 5 minutes, the patient also heals a Minor Injury Debuff.
If you spend 10 minutes, the patient also heals a Long-Term Minor Injury Debuff.
The patient regains 1 additional Health Bar slot. If you spend 15 minutes, the patient also heals a Major Injury Debuff.

system.limitations: After you treat someone, you can't treat them again until they complete a Short or Long Rest.
